map.时间码 01:00:00:00 在 24 fps 下 = (1×3600 + 0: Timecode 01:00:00:00 at 24 fps = (1×3600 + 0 + 0) × 24 + 0 = 86400 frames; the same timecode at 25 fps = 90000 frames, a difference of 3600 frames (i.e., 150 s). Therefore, cross-frame-rate projects should always hand off by total frames or seconds; timecode is only equivalent at the same frame rate.
